title: Dark mode: the tracking switch, Not Tracked in the list and the cycle count cell read correctly
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Dark theme turned on with the theme toggle; browser window 1366 px wide. Data: QAPL-T1 (tracked) and QAPL-U2 (untracked).
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory search QAPL-U2 and look at its Total Qty and bin chips; then search QAPL-T1.
  2. Open QAPL-T1 (Edit Inventory Part), look at "Track quantities and cost of goods", switch it off, then on again; close with Cancel.
  3. Search QAPL-U2, open ⋮ (button_inventory_actions) → Cycle count and look at its count cell; then Cancel.
  4. Resize the window to 1024 px and repeat steps 1 to 3.
custom_expected:
1. QAPL-U2's "Not Tracked" is muted but readable against the dark background and its bin chips are readable; QAPL-T1's "{n} available" badge is readable.
  2. The switch's on and off states are clearly distinguishable and the label, info icon and Min/Max fields are legible; Min and Max hide when off and return when on.
  3. The "Not Tracked" count cell (text_count_not_tracked_{id}) is legible with correct contrast and has no input.
  4. At tablet width the list, the dialog and the count cell lay out without clipping and read the same in the dark theme.
